title: Gold Holds Firm Above $3,740 as University of Michigan Inflation Expectations Anchor Yields
summary: Spot Gold held steady near $3,741/oz as the revised UoM survey confirmed long-run inflation expectations holding at 4.3%. Institutional bullion desks noted resilient ETF demand and safe-haven accumulation offsetting a flat U.S. Dollar Index.
aiRationale: Steady 4.3% long-run inflation expectations combined with sovereign reserve demand provide a durable floor under gold prices, mitigating headwind from firm nominal rates.

title: Dow Jones Advances 140 Points Led by Industrials as Consumer Sentiment Beats Preliminary Print
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (US30) climbed higher in afternoon trade as the Revised UoM Consumer Sentiment rose to 51.7 versus 51.0 previous. Blue-chip industrial bellwethers Caterpillar and Boeing led cyclical gains.
aiRationale: Upward revision in consumer sentiment underscores domestic aggregate demand resilience, expanding earnings multiples for cyclical Dow constituents.

title: Treasury Yields Consolidate Near Weekly Highs as FOMC Minutes and Jobs Prints Echo Across Rates
summary: The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield fluctuated near 4.42% while the Dollar Index traded rangebound around 106.8. Cross-asset traders weighed yesterday's lower jobless claims against cautious Federal Reserve commentary on December easing.
aiRationale: Rangebound Treasury yields around 4.42% cap near-term gold upside while allowing equity valuation discount rates to stabilize for industrial benchmarks.

title: Central Bank Gold Reserves Surge as Sovereign Diversification Offsets Dollar Volatility
summary: Official sector bullion purchases remained brisk heading into year-end as global reserve managers continued diversification away from single-currency debt holdings. Physical demand in Asian and European hubs provided strong bid depth.
aiRationale: Structural de-dollarization flows and sovereign reserve accumulation provide institutional price support independent of short-term interest rate fluctuations.
